lead.headline: Lost 125-71, and Tuten's leg is Week 12's question
lead.deck: Every AVIATO starter has played; 4-7. Diggs on the bench is all that is left.
lead.body: Bad news first: Bhayshul Tuten played hurt from the first snap and limped off again on Jacksonville's fourth-quarter drive (Yahoo); nothing has been released and the first Week 12 report is Wednesday. Likely caught one pass, Warren had 4.9, Allen threw two interceptions, and Metcalf, on your bench, was ejected and may be suspended for Friday (SteelerNation). AVIATO finish on 71.16 to Panda Attack's 125.2 — the projection lineup, with about 5 points on the bench before Diggs plays tonight. The Tuesday 16:00 run is the last before Wednesday's 02:00 claims.
